title: CareLens Full-Stack Product Build

assessment_snapshot.intro: The workspace currently contains a small, static CareLens web prototype with a report-picker interface and patient/clinician navigation:
bullets: Frontend is plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; the current UI lives in index.html and styles.css.
No backend, database, authentication, report processing, AI integration, clinician dashboard workflows, or automated tests are present.
The earlier product direction was responsive web, for patients and clinicians, with plain-language report understanding and clinician-preparation support.
The requested comparison app is not named or linked, so its features and visual design cannot yet be assessed.

proposed_outcome: Evolve the existing prototype into a responsive patient-and-clinician product with a polished frontend, secure backend and dashboards, and carefully bounded AI-assisted report explanations. Compare specific workflows and visual patterns against the reference app the user identifies. Before real patient data is handled, require appropriate privacy/security architecture and clinical validation; keep the AI informational, evidence-grounded, transparent about uncertainty, and defer diagnosis and treatment decisions to qualified clinicians.
